messages:
Alex: quick coordination for Thu's RFC walkthroughs — need to lock authors + reviewers and finalize ordering. who can take the 3rd slot? also please drop pre-reads to the thread by EOD Wed so reviewers have time.

Maria: I can take the 3rd slot (the new kv-caching RFC). good to confirm reviewer pair for that one.

Priya: i'll review kv-caching if someone else can pair with me for timing/infra questions. available Thu 10–1 or 3–5 PT.

Ryan: tagging in @Jen — Jen, you said you wanted to present the routing rollout plan. do you want an early slot or later?

Jen: I prefer an early slot so people aren't tired. happy to go first or second. will upload slides + a 1 page TL;DR by Wed noon.

Sam: i'm out Thu morning, but free after 2pm. can review routing or auth-sdk.

Alex: tentative ordering proposal (keeps infra-heavy early):
```
1) routing-rollout (Jen) — 20m + 10m q
2) auth-sdk migration (Sam) — 15m + 10m q
3) kv-caching (Maria) — 25m + 10m q
4) api-contracts (Priya) — 15m
```
If that looks okay i'll lock it and add reviewers: Jen -> Ryan, Sam -> Alex, Maria -> Priya + Ryan, Priya -> Maria.

Priya: that ordering works. i'd prefer to review kv-caching with Maria in the room for the latency bits.

rfc-bot: Reminder: Pre-read reminder sent to authors (Jen, Sam, Maria, Priya). Please attach PDFs or links in thread. Reaction :bell: added.

Maria: uploaded pre-read link: https://redwood.internal/docs/rfc/kv-caching-draft.pdf — highlights on page 2 about TTLs and cache shards.

Jen: uploaded slides: https://redwood.internal/slides/routing-rollout-v2.pdf. short bullets on fallback + canary.

Sam: added auth-sdk draft link and a tiny checklist in the doc with migration steps.

Alex: perfect. final ask: can someone (Ryan?) create the calendar invite and add reviewers as optional so we can A/B the slots if needed? i'll set agenda in the invite matching the order above.

Ryan: will create the invite in 10m and add reviewers as optional. i'll mark the meeting as 60m and include links + pre-read checklist.

Alex: thanks — i'll post a short pre-read checklist here for reviewers to follow: 1) read doc TL;DR 2) note any non-backwards-compatible changes 3) list questions for the author 4) call out infra/ops impacts. try to add comments inline.

Jen: noted. see you Thu. :thumbsup:

Priya: thanks everyone. I'll be ready for the kv-caching deep dive.

Sam: thanks, closing loop.
